definitions.gloss: extract; excerpt; selection; passage taken from a larger work
definitions.explanation: A portion selected from a longer text, document, speech, or other source. Also the act of selecting such a portion.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}から{重要|じゅうよう}な{部分|ぶぶん}を{抜粋|ばっすい}した。
examples.english: I excerpted the important parts from the paper.

examples.japanese: これは{小説|しょうせつ}の{一部|いちぶ}を{抜粋|ばっすい}したものです。
examples.english: This is an excerpt from a novel.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{議事録|ぎじろく}から{関連|かんれん}する{発言|はつげん}を{抜粋|ばっすい}して、{報告書|ほうこくしょ}にまとめた。
examples.english: I extracted relevant remarks from the meeting minutes and compiled them into a report.

notes:
USAGE:
{抜粋|ばっすい} is used with する as a transitive suru-verb. The source takes から, and the selected content takes を.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一部|いちぶ}を{抜粋|ばっすい}する (to excerpt a part)
- {記事|きじ}の{抜粋|ばっすい} (excerpt from an article)
- {抜粋|ばっすい}{版|ばん} (abridged edition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抜粋|ばっすい}: excerpt, extract (formal, selecting from a text)
- {引用|いんよう}: quotation, citation (reproducing someone else's words with attribution)
- {要約|ようやく}: summary (condensing the overall content)
